title: Five-Point Star with Blind Mounting Socket

Two entire inset material domains, one complete blind-cavity air domain extending through the open mouth, one full finite rectangular contact and two full ground soles. Generic triangulation and reviewed rendering/quality infrastructure are reused with explicit provenance. Native metres, Z up, front -Y, horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. Exactly one prop and zero scenes. No tree, light, illumination, cable, moving part, text, logo, texture, animation or variant. Static decorative game-art appearance only; no working mounting-fit, tree compatibility, retention, balance, load, material authenticity, manufacturing, installation, electrical, fire or safety certification.
